analysis.narrativeEn:

[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing resistance ($75.22): first resistance level on any short-term bounce.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (No Higher Low formed, sideways): trend reversal signals unconfirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.69x 5-day average): subdued confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (downtrend): maintain wait-and-see, conditions for buying not met.
